2610.10226.title: Why Software Engineering Is Indispensable in the Age of Coding Agents
2610.10226.paper_summary: Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) -- the discipline -- obsolete? And can it make software engineers -- the professionals -- redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.
2610.10226.paper_summary_zh: AI 能否使軟體工程（SE）這一學科變得過時？而它能否使軟體工程師這一職業變得多餘？本文主張，能幹的 AI 編碼代理的興起使得 SE 和軟體工程師變得不可或缺，而非過時：這是缺失的基礎，沒有它，AI 輔助的開發將產生誤導性地似乎合理、無法驗證且最終不可靠的軟體。大型語言模型的三個結構特性（概率生成、不可知論和語義無狀態性）創造了一個結構真空，這種真空無法通過任何訓練來消除。填補這一真空需要四個知識杠杆：方法論知識、領域知識、設計選擇和過程選擇。這四者必須具體化為持久的工件，而每一項都需要軟體工程師作為方法論者、中介者和監護人。
2610.10226.author: Alfonso Fuggetta et.al.
